summary: Tested valet dashboard stats and push notification features. All 11 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified valet stat cards (Cars Parked, Cars Retrieved, Tips Today) and admin stat cards (Active Valets, Vehicles, Tips Today) are correctly displayed based on user role.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/push/vapid-key returns VAPID public key (no auth required)
Backend: GET /api/valet/dashboard-stats requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: GET /api/valet/dashboard-stats returns cars_parked_today, cars_retrieved_today, tips_today
Backend: GET /api/admin/dashboard-stats returns active_valets, parked_vehicles, tips, totals
Backend: POST /api/push/subscribe stores subscription in push_subscriptions collection
Backend: POST /api/push/subscribe rejects invalid subscription (no endpoint)
Backend: POST /api/tickets validates vehicle_id (returns 404 for non-existent)
Backend: GET /sw.js serves service worker with push event handling
Frontend: Valet dashboard shows 3 stat cards (Cars Parked, Cars Retrieved, Tips Today) with data-testids valet-card-parked, valet-card-retrieved, valet-card-tips
Frontend: Admin dashboard shows 3 stat cards (Active Valets, Vehicles, Tips Today) with data-testids card-active-valets, card-vehicles, card-tips
Frontend: Valet stat cards hidden for admin users
Frontend: Admin stat cards hidden for valet users
Frontend: Push notification subscription hook (usePushNotifications.js) attempts to subscribe on login
Database: push_subscriptions collection stores user subscriptions correctly
seed_data_creation: None - used existing valet and admin data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Valet dashboard stats feature is fully working. Key data-testids: valet-card-parked, valet-card-retrieved, valet-card-tips (valet stat cards). Admin stat cards: card-active-valets, card-vehicles, card-tips. Push notification endpoints work correctly - subscriptions stored in push_subscriptions MongoDB collection. Service worker (sw.js) is served at /sw.js. The notify_team_of_retrieval function is called when tickets are created via POST /api/tickets. Tips data shows 0 as Stripe/Razorpay is not configured (MOCKED). Push notifications require browser permission which is denied in headless testing environment.
